mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by > 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the deteriorating labor market.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rose by > 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increased for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions or weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO dropped by > 2% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and simultaneously nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals a significant labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS decreased by > 100,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% in the same month, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increased by > 5% and RSAFS increased by > 1% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% in the same month, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 3% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increased by > 1% and UNRATE decreased by > 0.2% in the same month.
